title: Shinonome Akito — Outfit Assembler!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
This is our real starting point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna get even better.
We're gonna get Arata, Kotaro and EVER back...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our first step should probably be to secure more time together. Would that be a problem for anyone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That time can be used both for longer practices and for us to brainstorm our plans going forward.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (More time, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I gave it a lot of thought, and this seems to be my only option...)
Boutique Shop

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Then, Akito, let's do our best again today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um... Would we be able to chat for a minute after my shift?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (For now, I have a job to do...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hello.
Are you interested in this jacket?

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: Yeah, I was looking for something that goes well with a short-sleeved shirt underneath.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you have any particular fabrics or designs in mind, or any colors or anything? We have a fairly wide selection here.

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: Oh, I'm not really the fashion-conscious type... The clothes I usually get sort of all look the same, you know?

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: So, could you help me pick out an outfit?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of course. Then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Based on what he's wearing now, I doubt he'd usually go for clothing with printed patterns. But he also said he wants something different from his usual repertoire...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
How about something with a patterned inner lining?
We also have some interesting shirts that aren't too flashy.

rows.Speaker: Male Customer
rows.Line: You do?! Then, I'd like to try both of those!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much. I'll bring them over now.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Nice work today, Akito.
Your work ethic and customer service skills are always a huge help around here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! You asked earlier if we could chat! Now should be fine since we don't have any customers at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I need to leave this job.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me why...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need to invest more time into practicing.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I'd heard rumors that you and your friends battled against Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And how you heard about what happened to Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you also knew what RAD WEEKEND was actually about...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
I wish I could've told you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure what An would say, but I won't hold that against you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I want to say that I understand just how big an influence Nagi had on this town.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Our dream hasn't changed.
We're going to find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
...!
Right...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You said that you need more time to practice. Do you and your team already have a plan in mind?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, not yet... But we also need time to figure that out, which is why I'm doing this now...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, this can be your last day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?
Wait, I thought I had to give you a few days.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Under normal circumstances. But I'm making a special exception as your manager.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Yes... This may be shameless of me to say, but I am rooting for you guys...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Boss...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We absolutely promise to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me work here.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a wonderful employee. It was fun while it lasted. Be sure to drop by as a customer from time to time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will!
